name: Woolly Bactrian-Croc
notes: Heavy crocodile-mammal hybrid with two water-retention humps. Used by northern nomads to cross highland deserts.
journal_prompt: A heavy, rugged crocodile-mammal hybrid with two water-retention humps, used by northern nomads to cross the highland deserts.
appearance: A heavy, sprawling crocodyliform that survived in Asia into the age of mammals. Armoured moss-grey scales give way along the spine to a coat of thick, matted tawny fur, which frames two prominent fatty humps set just behind the heavy shoulder girdle.
